items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: I don't know if he was a person.

ctx.x: Hold on, played trumpet. Oh, I see.

Was Charlie older? Uh-huh. Was Charlie older? Yeah. Charlie... Edward was older. Mm-hmm. Did you know Happy Galloway? Huh? I think it was Charlie Galloway. Oh, Galloway. I wasn't talking Galloway. I don't know if he was a person. Did you know an accordion player named Peyton? Huh? Did you know an accordion player named Peyton?
Oh, Big Fat Peyton, yeah. Sure do, man. I was a kid. He used to play in Franklin Street.
